description: This file is a Python script that performs load testing on a language model API via a router interface. It imports modules, sets up model configurations, reads test questions from files, and executes concurrent API calls while logging responses and errors. It also summarizes the load test results.

methods.name: make_openai_completion
methods.description: Performs a completion request to the router with a given question, logs response or exception, and returns the response or None.
